populationRule: THE ADMITTED SET IS THE GIT-TRACKED SET, NOT THE DISK: per-checkout `git ls-files -z` under `$PWD/.corpus`, the router's extension list {scss} from script/m14/language-extensions.ts (`.sass` is the `sass`/css lanes' — 67 corpus files this analyzer is never given), present in the working tree, <= 1 MiB, dedup by realpath.
note: PATHS are `corpus-entry/relative-path` (the `.corpus` entries are symlinked checkouts). THE 2 OVER-CAP PATHS ARE CARRIED BY NAME rather than folded into a count: a reader can check them. INDEX=yes is the population's own property, not this artifact's: `.scss` is in src/ast/parallel-indexer.ts PROJECT_INDEX_EXTENSIONS and script/m14/incoming-gate.ts carries an SCSS_DECLARATION_SPEC, so production builds a project index for this language.
